notes: Found the real, confirmed cause of the victory screen showing up underneath/overlapping the board instead of covering it: three places in the game tried to set a display-layer value (z_index) to a number higher than the game engine allows, which silently failed every single time instead of erroring loudly. Fixed all three, including the one behind this exact bug.
fixes: The victory/defeat result screen (VICTORY or YOU LOSE with your rewards and buttons) was set to draw on a layer number the engine doesn't support, so it silently failed to move to the front and rendered underneath ordinary battlefield elements instead of covering them -- this is what caused it to look like a jumbled overlap of card art and text on every single win.
The card detail/inspection popup (long-press a card) had the same kind of invalid layer number and could be hidden behind other screen elements.
The pre-battle intro transition had the same kind of invalid layer number as well.
